arrival.note: A BOUND THE HYPOTHESIS CARRIES, NOT A READING. No source names these people, so none dates their coming. research_note: THE SECOND COMPANY OF THE 5TH INFANTRY, AT ESTABLISHMENT. NOBODY HERE IS NAMED BY ANY SOURCE. The Act of 2 March 1821 § 2 fixes an infantry company at one captain, one first lieutenant, one second lieutenant, three sergeants, four corporals, two musicians and forty-two privates; Andreas puts two companies of infantry at this post in 1833 and the post was held continuously to December 1836, but NO STRENGTH FIGURE FOR MID-1835 WAS REACHED. So the number is the establishment and not a return, which is a ceiling rather than a count — frontier companies stood below establishment as a matter of course. Ages are drawn inside the recruiting window the 1835 General Regulations art. 19 prints. Every name is invented and every value carries the seed that redraws it; a muster roll of this post for 1835 retires the whole card. No figure is drawn (docs/LIBERTIES.md L1).
